title: Feature Engineering
body:
These instructions are not identical to the similar question on midterm $$2$$, so please read carefully.
For each dataset depicted below in a scatterplot, fill in the squares next to all of the letters for the functions f that would make it possible to choose scalars $$ eta_0$$, $$ eta_1$$, $$and$$ $$ eta_2$$ such that $$y_i$$ $$=$$  eta_0 + x_i eta_1 + f(x_i) eta_2$$ for all $$(x_i, y_i)$$ pairs in the dataset. The input to each f is a scalar $$x$$ shown on the horizontal axis, and the corresponding $$y$$ value is shown on the vertical axis.

(A) $$f(x)$$ $$=$$ $$-x$$
(B) $$f(x)$$ $$=$$ $$x$$
(C) $$f(x)$$ $$=$$ x**{2}$$
(D) $$f(x)$$ $$=$$ $$|x|$$
(E) None of the above
lesson: Copy of Feature Engineering and Dimensionality
